Fact: required_hardware
What to find: Hardware required to run the model (e.g. GPU memory, number of accelerators).
Card sections that often contain it: Hardware, Requirements, Deployment

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Llama 4 Scout is released as BF16 weights but can fit within a single H100 GPU with on-the-fly int4 quantization (Maverick FP8 weights fit on a single H100 DGX host).
quotes: The Llama 4 Scout model is released as BF16 weights, but can fit within a single H100 GPU with on-the-fly int4 quantization; the Llama 4 Maverick model is released as both BF16 and FP8 quantized weights. The FP8 quantized weights fit on a single H100 DGX host while still maintaining quality.
